description: This file defines the abstract base class PdfAction in the PdfSharp library for handling PDF actions, including metadata, constructors, and key definitions used in PDF action dictionaries.

classes.name: PdfAction
classes.description: An abstract class representing the base for all PDF actions, handling common properties and initialization logic.

classes.name: PdfAction.Keys
classes.description: A nested class defining key constants and metadata for PDF action dictionaries, such as type and subsequent actions.

methods.name: PdfAction()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the 'Type' key to '/Action'.

methods.name: PdfAction(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the base class with a document reference and sets the 'Type' key.
